description: This file contains test utilities and mock socket classes for testing transport client socket pools in the Chromium net codebase. It defines mock socket classes, socket factory, and helper functions for testing socket connection behaviors.

classes.name: MockConnectClientSocket
classes.description: A mock socket that connects synchronously and successfully.

classes.name: MockFailingClientSocket
classes.description: A mock socket that fails to connect with a specified error.

classes.name: MockTriggerableClientSocket
classes.description: A mock socket that can be triggered to connect asynchronously, with support for delayed and stalled behaviors.

classes.name: MockTransportClientSocketFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates mock transport client sockets with configurable behaviors for testing.

classes.name: MockTransportClientSocketFactory::Rule
classes.description: Defines rules for socket creation behavior in the mock socket factory.

methods.name: ParseIP
methods.description: Parses an IP literal string into an IPAddress object.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedReused
methods.description: Tests load timing info for a reused socket handle.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedNotReused
methods.description: Tests load timing info for a non-reused socket handle.

methods.name: SetIPv4Address
methods.description: Sets an IPEndPoint to a specific IPv4 address.

methods.name: SetIPv6Address
methods.description: Sets an IPEndPoint to a specific IPv6 address.
